pages.text: Made from some Sniffer Fluff and Paper, this material can be used in the creation of Wrapped Candies.

Consuming a piece of wrapped candy will provide a random status effect, vanilla or modded.$(br)Right-clicking on a basin with potion contents will transfer 250mb (millibuckets) worth of contents to the wrapped candy, of which will now provide those effects upon consumption.
pages.title: Wrapped Candy

pages.text: Both the Candy Wrapping and Wrapped Candy can be dyed similar to leather armour.
